title: Distractor_software: Automated maze-task distractor generation for English, German, and Arabic
description:
Distractor_software generates maze-task distractor stimuli for psycholinguistic experiments in English, German, and Arabic. Built on Transformer-based language models (GPT-2), the pipeline selects real-word distractors that are contextually implausible while matching the target word in length and frequency range.

The tool was developed to produce the stimuli for the Master's thesis Dissecting the Maze Task with Eye-Tracking (University of Stuttgart) and subsequently generalized and released as open-source software. It adapts the original Maze repository by Victoria Boyce, adding distinct Transformer models, language-specific NLP tooling, GPU batch processing, semantic embedding filters, and an interactive configuration workflow.
